title: ReceiptCorrection
description: Body of PATCH /v1/receipts/{receipt_id} (ADR-039): the total or the date of a receipt as the user typed it, when the reader could not read it or read it with doubt. Sent by the app's form only: the copilot asks for the value but no agent tool corrects a receipt. The answer is the receipt as it now stands (outputs/document_ingest.schema.json#/$defs/receipt).
